query.description:
Supported items for filter: customerId, contractId

        - customerId: Filter by customer ID (use "eq" rule, e.g., customerId:eq:customer-id)

        - contractId: Filter by contract IDs (use "in" rule with pipe-separated values, e.g., contractId:in:id1|id2|id3)

response.name: Get all commitments with optional customer and contract filtering
